title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 8
description: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 8 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 in the Shadow's Embrace. Find the underjacking device, eliminate it and all witnesses, and return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Aftermath

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 in the Shadow's Embrace. Find the underjacking device, eliminate it and all witnesses, and return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I don't know why I didn't see this before. The Haxhaxors have been selling counterfeit King's Coins, investing into ectoplastics, and building computing engines. They've been using these computing engines to hack into the EctoTubes and keep Dungeon Runners from resurrecting!

I believe timing is now critical, so let me speak plainly. We've damaged their counterfeiting operation and put the fear of Gosh into their operatives, but we need to put the cap on the toothpaste, so to speak.

New evidence suggests that the Haxhaxor's run their underjacking operations out of alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 of the Shadow's Embrace. I'm sure you'll find their underjacking engine is somewhere in this area. Eliminate it and any technicians that are maintaining the device.

What are you waiting for? GO!

Turn-in:

Whew! Great job smashing that underjacking device! It's going to be a while before the Haxhaxors can get their operation back up to 100%. You saved Dungeon Running for everyone!

Objectives:

  • Take Out the Senior Technician
  • Take Out the Junior Technician

Client level range: 50–100
